INSERT INTO TB_PAYMENT ( PAYMENT_CODE, SUB_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, TOTAL_PRICE, PAYMENT_STAT, PAYMENT_METHOD, PAYMENT_DATE, CARD_COMPANY, RECENT_PAYMENT, NEXT_PAYMENT, BILLING_START, BILLING_END, PAYMENT_KEY, ORDER_ID, CREATED_BY, CREATE_DATE, UPDATED_BY, UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{paymentCode}, #{subCode}, #{companyCode}, #{totalPrice}, #{paymentStat}, #{paymentMethod}, #{paymentDate}, #{cardCompany}, #{recentPayment}, #{nextPayment}, #{billingStart}, #{billingEnd}, #{paymentKey}, #{orderId}, #{createdBy}, #{createDate}, #{updatedBy}, #{updateDate} )

SELECT c.COMPANY_CODE AS companyCode -- 회사코드 , c.COMPANY_NAME AS companyName -- 회사명 , c.BNO AS businessNumber -- 사업자번호 , c.CEO_NAME AS ceoName -- 대표자명 , c.CEO_PHONE AS ceoPhone -- 전화번호
, s.SUB_CODE AS subsCode -- 현재 구독코드 (없으면 NULL) , s.SUBS_STATUS AS subsStatus -- ACTIVE , st.CODE_NAME AS subsStatusName -- 구독 활성 / 구독 비활성
, s.PLAN_CODE AS planCode -- 현재 플랜코드 , p.PLAN_NAME AS planName -- 현재 플랜명
FROM TB_COMPANY_MASTER c LEFT JOIN TB_SUBSCRIBE s ON s.COMPANY_CODE = c.COMPANY_CODE AND s.SUBS_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' -- ★ 현재 구독만 LEFT JOIN TB_CM_CODE st ON st.GROUP_CODE = 'SUBS_STATUS' AND st.CODE = s.SUBS_STATUS LEFT JOIN TB_SUBSCRIBE_PLAN p ON p.PLAN_CODE = s.PLAN_CODE ORDER BY c.COMPANY_NAME

SELECT s.SUB_CODE AS subsCode -- 구독코드 , s.COMPANY_CODE AS companyCode -- 회사코드 , s.PLAN_CODE AS planCode -- 플랜코드 , p.PLAN_NAME AS planName -- 플랜명
, s.SUBS_STATUS AS subsStatus -- INACTIVE , st.CODE_NAME AS subsStatusName -- 구독 비활성
, s.INACTIVE_REASON AS inactiveReason -- CANCEL / EXPIRE / ... , rs.CODE_NAME AS inactiveReasonName-- 구독 해지 / 구독 만료 / 미납 정지 …
, s.SUBS_START AS subsStart -- 시작일 , s.SUBS_END AS subsEnd -- 종료일
, s.CURRENT_PRICE AS currentPrice -- 당시 금액 , s.CURRENT_USER_COUNT AS currentUserCount -- 당시 사용자 수
FROM TB_SUBSCRIBE s LEFT JOIN TB_SUBSCRIBE_PLAN p ON p.PLAN_CODE = s.PLAN_CODE LEFT JOIN TB_CM_CODE st ON st.GROUP_CODE = 'SUBS_STATUS' AND st.CODE = s.SUBS_STATUS LEFT JOIN TB_CM_CODE rs ON rs.GROUP_CODE = 'SUBS_INACTIVE_REASON' AND rs.CODE = s.INACTIVE_REASON WHERE s.COMPANY_CODE = #{comCode} -- 회사코드 파라미터 AND s.SUBS_STATUS = 'INACTIVE' -- ★ 과거 구독(비활성)만 ORDER BY s.SUBS_START DESC
